sentence: It is ___ to park here. You will get a fine.
hint: Think about the negative prefix for words starting with L
explanation: LEGAL → illegal (prefijo il-: que no es legal)

sentence: The instructions were ___. Nobody could understand them.
hint: Think about the negative prefix meaning 'not'
explanation: CLEAR → unclear (prefijo un-: que no es claro)

sentence: She was ___ to finish the project on time.
explanation: ABLE → unable (prefijo un-: que no es capaz)

sentence: I need to ___ my essay before submitting it.
explanation: WRITE → rewrite (prefijo re-: volver a escribir)

sentence: The company decided to ___ the old building.
explanation: BUILD → rebuild (prefijo re-: volver a construir)

sentence: I ___ with your opinion on this matter.
explanation: AGREE → disagree (prefijo dis-: lo opuesto de estar de acuerdo)

sentence: The old bridge has ___. We need a new one.
hint: The opposite of appear, in past tense
explanation: APPEAR → disappeared (prefijo dis-: dejar de aparecer, + pasado -ed)

sentence: This chair is very ___. You can sit in it for hours.
explanation: COMFORT → comfortable (sufijo -able: que tiene la cualidad de ser cómodo)

sentence: The food at that restaurant is always ___.
explanation: ENJOY → enjoyable (sufijo -able: que se puede disfrutar)

sentence: Is this water ___? I am very thirsty.

sentence: The ___ of the city has grown a lot in recent years.

sentence: We need to use ___ when we drive.

sentence: The ___ of the situation made everyone nervous.

sentence: His behaviour was completely ___. I could not believe it.
hint: Not acceptable — combine a prefix and a suffix
explanation: ACCEPT → unacceptable (prefijo un- + sufijo -able: que no se puede aceptar)

sentence: The damage to the car was ___. It could not be fixed.

sentence: She showed great ___ during the competition.

sentence: The weather is very ___ this week. It changes every hour.

sentence: They plan to ___ the kitchen next summer.
explanation: DECORATE → redecorate (prefijo re-: volver a decorar)

sentence: The ___ of the new product was a great success.

sentence: He felt a sense of ___ after losing the match.
explanation: DISAPPOINT → disappointment (sufijo -ment: el estado de estar decepcionado)

sentence: This old phone is completely ___ now. Nobody uses it.
explanation: USE → useless (sufijo -less: sin uso)

sentence: The task was ___. We finished it in five minutes.
explanation: DO → doable (sufijo -able: que se puede hacer)

sentence: She found the answer ___. It was not what she expected.
explanation: BELIEVE → unbelievable (prefijo un- + sufijo -able: que no se puede creer)

sentence: The ___ of the old building was completed last month.
explanation: CONSTRUCT → reconstruction (prefijo re- + sufijo -ion: construir de nuevo)

sentence: The ___ of the team led to their defeat.
hint: The noun form meaning lack of ability
explanation: ABLE → inability (prefijo in- + sufijo -ity: falta de habilidad)

sentence: She showed great ___ during the crisis.
explanation: RELY → reliability (sufijo -ability: la cualidad de ser confiable)

sentence: The instructions were ___. Nobody could follow them.
explanation: READ → unreadable (prefijo un- + sufijo -able: que no se puede leer)

sentence: The ___ of the contract caused many problems.
explanation: RENEW → renewal (sufijo -al: el acto de renovar)

sentence: The food was ___. We couldn't eat it.
explanation: EAT → uneatable (prefijo un- + sufijo -able: no apto para comer)

sentence: The ___ of the old factory created new jobs.
explanation: DEVELOP → redevelopment (prefijo re- + sufijo -ment: desarrollar de nuevo)

sentence: His ___ to change was frustrating for everyone.

explanation: WILLING → unwillingness (prefijo un- + sufijo -ness: no estar dispuesto)

sentence: The situation was ___. There was nothing we could do.

sentence: The ___ of the old system was necessary.

sentence: The ___ of the data was a serious problem.

explanation: SECURE → insecurity (prefijo in- + sufijo -ity: falta de seguridad)

sentence: The new policy was ___ to many employees.
explanation: FAIR → unfair (prefijo un-: no justo)

sentence: His ___ was clear from the way he spoke.
hint: The noun form meaning not being happy
explanation: HAPPY → unhappiness (prefijo un- + sufijo -ness: estado de no ser feliz)

sentence: His behaviour was completely ___. Even his best friends were shocked.

explanation: HONEST → dishonesty (prefijo dis- + sufijo -y: falta de honestidad)

sentence: Her ___ made it very hard to work with her on group projects.
hint: The noun form meaning lack of flexibility

sentence: His ___ grew as he waited for the delayed train.

explanation: PATIENT → impatience (prefijo im- + sufijo -ce: falta de paciencia)

sentence: The ___ of his closest friend hurt him deeply.
